# Robert Tanaka — Director, Perioperative Services

- **Relationship:** Diane's direct report; runs the 22-OR perioperative service at the flagship
  plus surgical services at the other sites.
- **Cadence:** weekly 1:1.
- **What he owns:** [OR Block Schedule Redesign](../projects/or-block-schedule.md); surgeon
  block allocation and OR utilization.

## How to work with him
- Data-driven and diplomatic; effective at managing prickly surgeon politics.
- Block utilization is stuck at ~68% vs a 75% target — the redesign is his main lever.

## Sensitivities
- Reclaiming under-used surgeon blocks is politically charged; loop in
  [Priya Anand](priya-anand.md) (CMO) before any block is pulled.
